question_1.question: Are our products Halal?
question_1.answer: Yes, each ingredient has its Halal certificate and OEM Halal certification for the production process.

Soft pastilles are a source of plant-based Ascorbate (Vitamin C) antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds to help your body and mind stay active.

question_5.question: Why are MCTs included?

question_6.answer: Place a soft-pastille twice or thrice daily under your tongue for faster absorption, or as advised by your doctor, counsellor, pharmacist, or nutritionist.

The unique blend of natural Vitamin C, amino acids, glycoproteins, polyphenols, and ALA-Omega 3 works together (nutrient synergy) to support muscle recovery, strengthen skin and nails, and improve joint comfort and flexibility; helping you feel alert and ready for daily activity.

question_10.answer: Yes! These soft pastilles are specially crafted to support women’s wellness; helping boost energy and mood, enhance skin hydration, promote hormonal balance, and nurture overall vitality for a beautiful you.

question_11.question: How should I store the product?

GutBrainAxis.mainTitle: COMMUNITY OUTREACH TALK for PARENTS of CHILDREN with ASD and ADHD

article.heading: Nutrient Dense Soft Pastilles increase Gut Brain Axis (GBA) Functionality*
article.paragraph1: The gut and brain communicate bidirectionally through the GBA via neural, endocrine, and immune pathways. Dietary choices are a major factor in modulating this communication.
article.paragraph2: Nutrient-dense soft pastilles containing beneficial ingredients such as resistant starch (paleo prebiotics), omega-3 and MCTs, polyphenols (antioxidants), pro-collagen, ascorbate, vitamin complex, and minerals can positively impact the GBA by influencing neurotransmitter production, thus prompting a sense of wellbeing.
article.paragraph3: When formulated with purely organic ingredients, soft pastilles can offer a safe, convenient and effective way to support GBA functionality.
article.resistantStarchContent: Feeds beneficial gut bacteria (commensal microbes). These probiotics ferment this fiber into beneficial metabolites, notably short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), which improves intestinal barrier function, reduce systemic and neuro inflammation.
article.omega3Content: Are crucial for brain development and learning. They increase good cholesterol and ketone bodies which is linked to better mood regulation and a lower risk of depression.
article.polyphenolsContent: Have been studied to reduce free radicals, regulate LDL and trans-fats and improve inflammatory responses.
article.vitaminsContent: Ascorbate, B vitamins, folate, zinc, and magnesium are involved as coenzymes and cofactors in the metabolic pathways that affect the development and functioning of the nervous system and neuro hormones.
article.probioticsContent: When paired with nutrient-rich soft pastilles, as reported in several probiotic–nutrition synergy studies, these med-grade probiotics supports clearer focus, calmer mood, and healthier digestion. Research in children shows benefits in strengthening natural immunity and easing seasonal flu-like or allergy-related discomfort.
article.mechanismContent: The components of nutrient-dense soft pastille can act as a delivery system for "psychobiotics" (dietary factors that influence the microbiota with positive effects on mental health), supporting the gut-brain axis, medication efficacy and overall well-being.
